name: @projexlight/registry-mcp-local
summary: Stdio MCP server bundled with the projex CLI. Speaks MCP wire protocol v1 over stdio so any MCP-aware AI client (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline) plugs in via mcp.json. Caches the catalog locally; READ tools answered offline; writes proxy to the hosted services/registry-mcp.

hooks.name: initializeServer
hooks.description: Build the MCP Server with list/call handlers.

hooks.name: runStdio
hooks.description: Connect on stdio; resolves when the transport closes.

scenarios.title: Claude Code spawns the MCP via mcp.json
scenarios.when_to_use: After `projex init`, the user's ~/.claude/mcp.json points at this binary; Claude Code spawns it as a child process via stdio.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Claude Code spawns the server. ListTools returns projex_registry_search_sdks, get_manifest, get_example, list_compatible_sdks, list_blueprints, get_blueprint, scaffold.

scenarios.title: Catalog cached locally → offline search works
scenarios.when_to_use: After `projex registry refresh`, the catalog + embeddings live under ~/.projex/cache; search continues to work without network.
scenarios.expected_outcome: All READ tools answered from local cache. Writes proxy to hosted MCP (Phase 2).

scenarios.title: Dev mode uses the in-repo build
scenarios.when_to_use: Monorepo developer sets PROJEX_DEV_ROOT; the local MCP loads the catalog from packages/sdk-registry/dist instead of the user cache.
scenarios.example_code: // projex init writes: { command: 'node', args: [path, '...'], env: { PROJEX_DEV_ROOT: '...' } }
scenarios.expected_outcome: Dev edits to manifests reflect in the MCP without rebuild-publish-install cycle.

scenarios.title: Coexists with Projexlight's dev MCP
scenarios.when_to_use: Per FR-COHAB-2 — all tool names prefixed projex_registry_* so they can't collide with the existing projexlight_* dev MCP when both are loaded.
scenarios.example_code: // Both MCPs visible to Claude Code; the LLM sees both tool families distinctly.
scenarios.expected_outcome: No tool-name collisions. Each MCP can be enabled/disabled independently.

compliance_posture.notes: Read-only on the local; no write surface; no PII handled. Sandbox-friendly.
